# Inherited DASH qualification

These receipts cover the bounded XML tree, representation selection, inherited
SegmentList/SegmentTemplate addressing, BaseURL resolution, owned escaped URI
references, allocation-failure cleanup and authenticated HTTP transport.

Linux ARM64 ran the portable media tests in a local container with networking
disabled. The macOS suite also runs the production HTTP/object-store integration
tests against local authenticated servers. Source hashes identify the qualified
implementation; no pretrained model or codec-conformance claim follows from
these media tests. Automatic multi-period playback and stable live period
cursors remain implementation work.
